items.exampleEn: This table folds flat, so it's easy to carry.
items.exampleZh: 這張桌子可以摺平，很方便攜帶。

items.exampleEn: The balloon burst with a loud noise.
Please keep your possessions with you at all times.
items.exampleZh: 請隨時把你的財物帶在身邊。

items.exampleEn: The cat leaped onto the table.
These plants can endure very cold winters.
items.exampleZh: 這些植物能忍受非常寒冷的冬天。

items.exampleEn: The long trip put a strain on the old dog.
items.exampleZh: 長途旅行讓那隻老狗吃不消。

items.exampleEn: Do you know what the trigger for his anger was?
items.exampleZh: 你知道他生氣的起因是什麼嗎？

items.exampleEn: The engineers modified the design of the car.
items.exampleZh: 工程師們修改了這輛車的設計。

items.sentenceEn: Can you help me fold this big map?
items.sentenceZh: 你能幫我摺這張大地圖嗎？

items.audioEn: The shop can modify the dress so that it fits you better.
items.audioZh: 店家可以修改這件洋裝，讓它更合身。

items.sentenceEn: Leap over the small stream, or your shoes will get wet.
items.sentenceZh: 跳過那條小溪，不然鞋子會濕。

items.stemEn: She ____ the letter in half and put it in an envelope.
items.stemZh: 她把信對摺，放進信封裡。

items.stemEn: Losing his job caused a lot of ____ in the family.
items.stemZh: 他失業給家裡帶來很大的壓力。

items.passageEn: Last summer, my family moved to a new city because of my dad's new job. Packing was a big strain on everyone. My mom asked us to fold all our clothes and put them in boxes. My most precious possession is my old guitar, so I carried it myself. On moving day, a box burst open, and books fell everywhere! We had to endure two hot days with no air conditioning. The heat was the trigger for a lot of complaints, but we soon laughed about it. In the new house, we modified the plan for our rooms, so I got the biggest one. When I saw it, I leaped with joy.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，因為爸爸的新工作，我們全家搬到一座新的城市。打包對每個人都是很大的負擔。媽媽要我們把所有衣服摺好放進箱子裡。我最珍貴的財產是我的舊吉他，所以我自己拿著它。搬家那天，一個箱子突然破開，書掉得到處都是！我們還得忍受兩天沒有冷氣的炎熱日子。這股熱氣引來了一堆抱怨，但我們很快就一笑置之。在新家，我們修改了房間的分配計畫，所以我得到了最大的那間。看到房間時，我高興得跳了起來。

options: 原本的房子租約到期了
想住得離學校更近一點

questions.questionZh: 搬家那天發生了什麼事？
options: 搬家公司的卡車在路上壞了
一個箱子破開，書掉滿地

items.promptZh: 我們得忍受很長的等待。
referenceEn: We had to endure a long wait.
We had to endure waiting for a long time.
rubricZh: endure 表示「忍受」，例如 endure a long wait 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.promptZh: 搬家時，他只帶了幾件個人物品。
referenceEn: When he moved, he took only a few personal possessions.
He only took a few of his possessions when he moved.
rubricZh: 用 possession 的複數表示「財物；物品」
